text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After picking up some training supplies at the shopping district, Mejiro Ardan and I are on our way back.
choice_data_list: Thanks for coming shopping with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not at all. These are all things I use regularly during training, and besides, I'm sure you're very busy, so it's my pleasure to be of assistance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Oh? Isn't that…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my, a raffle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's been such a long time since I last saw one! And it's quite an old-school raffle machine, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suddenly remember that we received a complimentary raffle ticket when I purchased the training supplies earlier.
choice_data_list: Do you want to have a go at the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: R-really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But the ticket came with something that you bought.
choice_data_list: Well, this shopping trip was for your benefit, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. Well, when you put it that way, I find myself quite tempted to see whether I can win.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Greetings, young lady! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes please, I'd like to have a go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan gives the raffle machine a powerful spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: You did it, Ardan!
You did it, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Um… Are the grand prizes won quite frequently?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Not at all, young lady! The grand prize is called the grand prize precisely because of its rarity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh yes, of course. My apologies, I was simply so stunned that I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even so… is it really all right for me to accept the grand prize?
choice_data_list: This must be karma for all your good deeds.
This must be karma for all your good deeds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In that case… I'm equally honored and thankful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Considering that I've been defying fate itself in an effort to leave my mark on the present… I never expected to receive such a blessing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Your phrasing earlier implied that this win was my doing, Trainer, but the raffle ticket was yours to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As such, this coupon… should be left in your hands, don't you think?
choice_data_list: I don't mind holding onto it, but it belongs to you.
I don't mind holding onto it, but it belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, since I won the grand prize using your raffle ticket, Trainer, I was thinking that it might be best if the two of us discussed how best to use it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In this moment, I'm pinning absolutely everything on racing. I expect I'd struggle to spare the time and mental space needed to enjoy a vacation.
choice_data_list: All right, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: When the time is suitable… let us discuss how best to utilize this travel coupon.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The first prize?! To think that I'd have such luck playing a raffle on a whim…
choice_data_list: You did it, Ardan!
You did it, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: All things considered, though, this is a very generous serving. And it's not simply an enormous portion either—it's been cooked to perfection as well…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wonder how one might best savor this dish.
choice_data_list: It looks delicious.
It looks delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer… would you like to partake of this hamburger steak with me later?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, this all started with the raffle ticket you received with your shopping. I merely used the ticket.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: One could say that we earned this prize together, so it follows that we should also enjoy it together…
choice_data_list: In that case, I think I will partake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I insist.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With that decided, let's purchase some sauce and garnishes on our way back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This meal's going to be a special treat, so I'd very much like to present it as nicely as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on, Mejiro Ardan and I enjoy the mouthwateringly delicious deluxe carrot hamburger steak together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Honestly, I never even considered that I might win something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Delighted as I am, the sheer number of carrots here is simply overwhelming.
choice_data_list: Why don't you share them with your friends?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course! What a splendid idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: These carrots here are for you, Trainer, since you obtained the ticket. And these carrots are mine, as I won the prize. I shall give the rest of them to my friends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking of making a meal out of our combined share of carrots. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Do any recipes that use carrots come to mind?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, after thoroughly enjoying the carrot dish Mejiro Ardan makes, I feel greatly revitalized and ready to take on tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I won something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What a lovely carrot. One can tell it was grown with painstaking care and attention. In fact, I expect it would taste quite wonderful as is…
choice_data_list: Why not eat it right now then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Wouldn't that be a little uncouth?
choice_data_list: Just think of it as a quick snack.
Just think of it as a quick snack.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. "A quick snack," you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I must admit, that does sound fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course. Seeing as one doesn't get to see a carrot of this caliber every day, would you like to share it with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, on our way back, Mejiro Ardan and I enjoy the delicious carrot together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh… It's a consolation prize…
choice_data_list: That's a shame…
That's a shame…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Only receiving the consolation prize is… unexpectedly disheartening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I suppose one can't help but feel suddenly optimistic as one pulls the raffle lever. This has been a great learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for allowing me to partake in the raffle, Trainer. Considering how rare an opportunity this was, I was hoping to win something we might share…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I apologize for having failed to make that a reality.
choice_data_list: It's totally fine. You don't have to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she doesn't say or show it, I can tell Mejiro Ardan feels a little dejected…
